WITH meses AS (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month',data_lancamento),'YYYY-MM') mes,
         COALESCE(SUM(valor) FILTER (WHERE classe='despesa'),0) despesa,
         COALESCE(SUM(valor) FILTER (WHERE classe='receita'),0) receita
  FROM financas_lancamentos
  WHERE data_lancamento >= DATE_TRUNC('month',(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) - INTERVAL '2 months'
    AND data_lancamento < DATE_TRUNC('month',(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) + INTERVAL '1 month'
    AND data_lancamento <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
  GROUP BY 1
),
topcat AS (
  SELECT categoria, SUM(valor) total, COUNT(*) qtd FROM financas_lancamentos
  WHERE classe='despesa' AND data_lancamento > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - 30 AND data_lancamento <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
  GROUP BY categoria ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 6
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'periodo', TO_CHAR((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date,'DD/MM/YYYY'),
  'meses',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(m ORDER BY m.mes DESC),'[]'::json) FROM meses m),
  'topcat',(SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.total DESC),'[]'::json) FROM topcat t),
  'invest',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor_atual),0) FROM financas_investimentos WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(valor_atual,0)>0),
  'faturas_total',(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor_fatura_atual),0) FROM financas_faturas WHERE valor_fatura_atual>0)
) AS relatorio;
